description: Activate when the user wants to audit a paper's empirical or technical claims against a linked code repository — checking whether experiments, datasets, models, metrics, and hyperparameters described in the paper actually exist and match the code. Produces a structured audit report classifying each claim as CONFIRMED, PARTIAL, MISSING, or MISMATCH, with file/line evidence. Useful for reproducibility checks, reviewer due diligence, and pre-submission self-audits of ML/CS/empirical papers that ship code.
